# EmoteWheel

Emote wheel for Tears of the Kingdom 1.2.1, built with WiiXLaunch.

Build with devkitPro/devkitA64: `make -j4`. See [BUILDING.txt](BUILDING.txt).
Output: `deploy/subsdk4` and `deploy/main.npdm`.

Mod/WiiXLaunch code: GPL-3.0. Dependencies keep their original licenses;
see [THIRD_PARTY.txt](THIRD_PARTY.txt), including the GPL version compatibility note.
Game assets, animations, and music are not included.
